items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Improved Matrix visual performance for large table
items.summary: Business Performance Planning introduce Virtualization to optimizes how the Matrix visual renders large planning datasets. Rather than loading and displaying the entire dataset at once, the visual progressively renders the rows and columns needed as users scroll, expand, collapse, and navigate through the Matrix. This reduces the amount of data processed by the browser at any one time and helps maintain visual responsiveness at scale.GA date: October CY2026

items.summary: Organizations often use business-specific data and criteria to determine when suppliers require follow-up on purchase orders. The Procurement Agent will enable buyers to extend supplier follow-up criteria using related standard, extended, and custom table data. items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Scheduling with Copilot
items.summary: Users can now schedule appointments and meetings directly from chat. Simply ask Copilot to create an appointment or schedule a meeting with colleagues, and it will find available times, book rooms, draft agendas, and send invites—all within the chat experience.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover and use shared plugins in Copilot Studio
items.summary: Copilot Studio now connects to Microsoft's shared plugin registry, making it easier for makers to discover and use plugins, connectors, and other available capabilities. This integration provides a more consistent way to extend agents with capabilities across Microsoft's AI ecosystem.GA date: November CY2026Preview date: October CY2026

items.summary: Users can more easily work with SharePoint files in Outlook by saving email attachments directly to SharePoint and searching across SharePoint sites for files from the file picker.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
items.summary: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees, enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
items.summary: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
items.summary: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the eventGA date: November CY2026

items.title: Outlook: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
items.summary: The first updates will focus on visual details, such as icons, spacing and alignment. Users of classic Outlook for Windows will begin seeing refinements to familiar mail and calendar surfaces. The initial visual updates are intended to improve clarity and consistency without changing how users perform their tasks.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: SharePoint: AI input widget and content preview in Copilot
items.summary: With this new capability, users of Copilot in SharePoint will be able to view saved and unsaved preview content side by side with chat.  Users will also be able to interact with created HTML forms and confirm responses to send to chat.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Review financial dimensions when approving expenses on mobile
items.summary: Approvers need access to the financial information behind an expense to make accurate approval decisions without leaving the approval experience. Dynamics 365 expense management mobile app will surface relevant financial dimensions directly within expense report approvals in the mobile app. Approvers can review financial coding in context before making a decision, helping reduce unnecessary navigation and keep expense approvals moving.GA date: December CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Track mileage expenses using kilometers
items.summary: Organizations operating across different regions need to record mileage expenses using the units of measure appropriate for their employees and local requirements. Dynamics 365 Project Operations will support kilometers (km) as a configurable unit of measure for mileage expenses, in addition to miles. Organizations can configure the appropriate mileage unit for their business, helping employees record mileage expenses accurately using the measurement standard relevant to their regional requireme

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Event Chat now available for Events optimized for a large audience in GCC

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for Network Device Interface (NDI) Sources
items.summary: For Teams meetings and events, a new streaming switchboard will soon be available to easily manage and send NDI sources out to production software.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
items.summary: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. In this mode you can create, rename, and delete pages, sections, or notebooks as well as add or edit content in pages. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
items.summary: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web.GA date: November CY2026
